text:
marta: Heads-up — Coho private VPC deploy window tomorrow 02:00–03:30 UTC. Plan: DB schema bump + runtime agent rollout. Need owners for terraform/apply, runtime image switch, smoke sanity, and rollback readiness. CI tag: release/coho/2026-03-18. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/coho-private-cutover. Who can take what?

jason: I can own runtime agent rollout + traffic switch. Will be online for the window. I'll push the smoke script to infra repo and post link here.

liyah: I'll handle infra (terraform apply, VPC peering, firewall rules). Plan to do a staged apply (staging -> prod). Please give me a 10m heads-up before prod apply.

devon: I'll handle monitoring & rollback ops. Proposed alerts to watch: error rate > 2% (1m), p99 latency > 1000ms. If either fires, we pause and evaluate. I'll create the temp alert channel.

priya: I'll coordinate with the Coho SE and run functional smoke (auth, basic RPCs). I have test creds. Smoke checklist I want: generate endpoint, embeddings endpoint, and a lightweight end-to-end on their front-end.

jason: Smoke script pushed — infra/smoke/coho_smoke.sh commit abc123 (git.internal:redwood/infra). Quick smoke checklist I plan to run: 1) ./coho_smoke.sh --host coho.private --key $SMOKE_KEY (run 3x), 2) verify KV cache warmed (logs show cache hits), 3) run 20rps small load for 2m and watch error rate.

marta: Rollback plan: revert runtime image to release/coho/prev, and revert terraform to last-known-good tfstate (s3://redwood-tfstates/coho/snap-2026-03-17). @jason @liyah confirm you have the prev image and tfstate snapshot.

liyah: Confirmed — I have the tfstate snapshot and the snapshot of security groups. I will not apply prod until smoke returns green and @marta gives the green light.

devon: I'll create alert group `coho-deploy-critical` and add escalation to @marta and @jason. If alert fires, paging on-call and we follow rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued — job id 89321. ETA start: 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/89321.

marta: Final ownership: @jason runtime/traffic, @liyah infra/apply, @devon monitoring/rollback, @priya customer verification. I'll start a 15m countdown at 01:45 UTC tomorrow and post the go/no-go. Please ack if you can make the window. :thumbsup:

jason: :thumbsup: ready.

priya: Ack — I'll be on the call with Coho SE.

devon: Standing by and will watch alerts.

marta: Thanks folks — short and sweet. If anything changes post-00:00 UTC I'll update here.
